title: Miraculous World
description: A new miraculouus minecraft mod that has a bunch of customizable stuff and cool features and awesome models
body:
A new miraculouus minecraft mod that me and my best friend made

It includes many features and many customizable stuff

 

- Choose your suit
- Choose your camouflage mode

- Choose your alignment of good or evil

- Toggle Many settings such as: lucky charm vision,, mlb save, force transformation, miraculous timers.. etc

 

Adds Various Lucky Charms and blocks to help you in your survival world

Adds Various suits and camouflages for everyone to use

Adds VFX and soon animated textures

And fear not, because this mod is just getting started.


 For now it includes the following miraculous:

- Ladybug = ✔️

- Cat  = ❌

- Butterfly  = ✔️
